reasoning_content:
current_phase falls back to phases.published.last which orders by id, so the "finished" phase is not last (ids out of order). The seeds expect `Budget.finished.first` to be non-nil. I'll adjust the seed to look up finished by phase kind directly, i.e. use `Budget.find { |b| b.finished? }` or update the phase to finished properly.

Simplest: define a helper in the seed that picks the budget whose `phases.finished` exists. Or set the budget's phases so finished is current. Actually simpler to change `Budget.finished.first` to `Budget.all.find { |b| b.phases.finished.present? }`. But `Budget.finished` scope uses select(&:finished?) which uses current_phase which is broken.

Let me just change seeds to use the budget created with phase "finished" — find by phase column? The `phase` column persisted "finished" for the first budget. So I can use `Budget.find_by(phase: "finished")`. Then `.headings` — custom Budget has_one :heading through group. The seed uses `budget.headings.all.sample` which won't work (no headings association). Let me check.

Actually Budget has_one :heading. So `budget.headings` fails. Let me patch Winner Investments to use `budget.heading`.

Also `Budget::Heading.all.sample` fine.

Let me update the balloting/winner sections.

action.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PY'
p="db/dev_seeds/budgets.rb"
s=open(p).read()
old='''section "Balloting Investments" do
  Budget.finished.first.investments.last(20).each do |investment|
    investment.update(selected: true, feasibility: "feasible")
  end
end

section "Winner Investments" do
  budget = Budget.finished.first
  50.times do
    heading = budget.headings.all.sample'''
new='''section "Balloting Investments" do
  Budget.find_by(phase: "finished").investments.last(20).each do |investment|
    investment.update(selected: true, feasibility: "feasible")
  end
end

section "Winner Investments" do
  budget = Budget.find_by(phase: "finished")
  50.times do
    heading = budget.headings.sample'''
assert old in s, "balloting block not found"
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
old2='''  budget.headings.each do |heading|
    Budget::Result.new(budget, heading).calculate_winners
  end'''
new2='''  Array(budget.heading).each do |heading|
    Budget::Result.new(budget, heading).calculate_winners
  end'''
assert old2 in s
s=s.replace(old2,new2,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("patched")
PY
grep -n "budget.heading\|find_by(phase" db/dev_seeds/budgets.rb
